authority_reference: Owner instruction, 2026-11-09: office invitation, in-person verification, then final membership approval and confirmation email
privacy_notice: Your submitted details are saved privately for authorized Association staff to review your membership application. Confirm your details before submitting. Visit the Help Desk for verification and corrections. Only an administrator can approve membership and create a member record. For online applications, your email and PWD number are required. The Association uses its Gmail account to send pending-review notices and an invitation to visit the barangay office to verify your information. Bring your PWD ID. Your application remains pending until office verification and final Admin approval. A separate email then confirms your Association membership. Your original submission and review history are retained; ask the Help Desk about retention and privacy requests. Save or print your receipt before finishing, and protect downloaded copies on shared devices.
